name: Churches
overview: The Scriptures reveal that the church is a divinely established community founded by Christ, who promised its enduring strength against all opposition. Early believers devoted themselves to apostolic teaching, fellowship, prayer, and the breaking of bread, reflecting the intimate and spiritual nature of house churches. Church leaders are entrusted by the Holy Spirit to shepherd the congregation, which Christ redeemed with His own blood. Believers are called to nurture one another through teaching, worship, and encouraging love and good works, emphasizing the church's role as a nurturing and spiritually vibrant body.
